title: Facet screen spec or deck
description: Generated by tools/gen_catalogue.mjs from core/spec.h (catalogue 2e3f436b). Not validated here: core/spec.h is the validator.

about.description: What the setting does, in one or two plain sentences (docs, editor)

selected.description: Which accent colour is ringed as the chosen one. current follows the colour the panel uses now; the others pick that accent set by name.

state.description: How the swatches look: default can be tapped; disabled is dimmed and ignores taps; unavailable shows the colour cannot be read right now.

context.description: Where the swatches sit: alone on their own, or settings-row tucked into the right end of a row on a settings page.

value.description: How far round the arc is filled, from 0 (empty) to 100 (full).

size.description: How wide the arc is across, in pixels.

knob.description: Shows a round knob at the end of the filled part, the handle you drag on a dial.

state.description: default draws the arc in the accent colour; disabled greys it out to show it cannot be changed.
How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while a finger is on it, or disabled when there is nowhere to go back to.

values.description: The height of each bar, as numbers separated by commas, one bar per number from left to right.

colour.description: How the bars are coloured: bands colours each bar by its price band (cheap, normal, peak); series draws every bar in the one chart colour.

now.description: Which bar is now, counting from 0 on the left; it gets the dotted now marker. -1 shows no marker.

width.description: How wide the whole chart is, in pixels; 0 fills the space it is in.

height.description: How tall the tallest bar can be, in pixels.

scrub.description: Lets you press and drag along the chart to read the value of each bar.

ticks.description: Hour labels on the axis under the bars, every this many hours (6 = 00, 06, 12, 18); 0 shows none.

compare.description: An earlier period to set the values against, one number per value: the bars come in pairs, the earlier one as an outline. Empty shows single bars.

labels.description: One word per value (or pair) on the axis under the bars, such as the days of a week; they replace the hour labels.

legend.description: Words naming the series over the bars, each after its swatch: the values first, then the compare period.

marks.description: A moon over some bars, one word per bar: full or new (empty = none), such as the full and new moons over their days.

names.description: One word per bar that the reading names when you press it, such as its date; empty uses the axis words or the hour.

unit.description: The unit after a value when you read a bar, such as kWh or %.

colours.description: The bins' colours, separated by commas, the first in front: black, green, brown, blue, grey, purple, red or yellow.

size.description: hero is the big picture; card is the small picture at the top right of a Home card.

colours.description: The bins' colours, separated by commas, the first in front.

caption.description: The small caption over the day, such as put out tonight.

accent.description: Draws the caption in the accent colour, for when the bins go out tonight or today.

when.description: The day of the collection, such as Tomorrow, Today or a weekday.

bins.description: Which bins go out, such as Green + Black bins.

line.description: The date and how often, such as Fri 24 Oct · every 2 weeks.

open.description: Whether the sheet is showing (open) or hidden off the bottom of the screen (closed). Changing it slides the sheet in or out.

list.description: For previews only: which made-up list fills the sheet, the speakers to play on or the light and dark theme choices.

title.description: The heading at the top of the sheet. Leave empty to use the list's own title.

selected.description: Which row is chosen, counting from 0 at the top; its radio is on.

screen.description: For previews only: draws a sample screen under the sheet so you can see it dim behind the scrim.

kind.description: How strong the button looks: primary is filled in the accent for the main action, secondary is a quieter fill, outline is just an edge, ghost is text only for the least important action.

state.description: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, active when it is the chosen one, active-pressed while the chosen one is held, or disabled when it cannot be used.

icon.description: An icon shown before the words, or none for words only.

size.description: normal is the full button height; small is the smallest touch height with less padding, for an action inside a row such as a section header's See all.

width.description: hug fits the button to its words; fill stretches it across the space it is in, with the words centred.

hold.description: Hold to confirm, for an action that must not happen by accident such as opening a door: a tap does nothing; the button fills while held and acts only when full.

hold_label.description: The words shown while the button is held, such as Opening. Empty keeps the label.

hold_time.description: How long a hold takes to confirm, in milliseconds.

value.description: What a completed hold sends, such as open. Empty sends the label.

title.description: The month shown, such as October 2026.

here.description: Whether this month is the one shown: Today is offered only for another month.

days.description: The 42 days of the six weeks shown, a JSON list: each with its date d, number n, out (another month), today, sel (the day open), dots (up to three calendar colours, comma separated) and more (+2 when there are more).

kind.description: What the row is: day is a day's label over its events, event is one event, calendar is one calendar you can show or hide.

title.description: The words: the day (today · Thu 22 Oct), the event's title or the calendar's name.

time.description: An event's time, such as 16:50, now or all day.

colour.description: The calendar's colour for its dot: blue, ok, warn, steel, text-dim, text, error or accent.

tone.description: An event's moment: empty for later, now while it runs (the time in the accent), past when it is over (quieter).

first.description: A day's label at the top of the list, with no space above it.

status.description: A calendar's quieter line, such as 5 events or hidden.

on.description: Whether a calendar is shown: its checkbox is ticked and its dot takes its colour.

label.description: The card's name, shown next to its icon at the top.

icon.description: The small icon before the name, or none.

preview.description: The small picture at the top right of the card, such as the weather now or the record that is playing, or none.

weather.description: With the weather preview: which weather icon it shows, such as rain-light (the weather now).

visual.description: With the media preview: the picture, as the Media screen shows it (disc, cassette, cd or vinyl).

progress.description: With the media preview: how far through the track it is, from 0 to 100. With the timer preview: how much of the running timer is left, out of 1000 (empty when none runs).

playing.description: With the media preview: whether it is playing (the picture turns).

art.description: With the media preview: the album art's address, printed on the disc, CD or record. Empty: the plain picture.

run.description: With the vacuum preview: run while the robot is out cleaning (progress = the run's), idle at rest (progress = the battery), off when it cannot be reached.

position.description: With the covers preview: how open the window is, from 0 (closed) to 100 (open).

phase.description: With the moon preview: where the moon is in its month, from 0 (new) through 0.5 (full) to 1.

south.description: With the moon preview: draws the moon as seen from the southern half of the world.

planes.description: With the flights preview: the aircraft round home, as the flights feed gives them.

colours.description: With the bins preview: the bins' colours, separated by commas, the first in front.

mode.description: What the middle of the card shows: value is a big short value such as 13°; text is a line of words such as the song playing.

value.description: The big value shown in the middle when the mode is value.

text.description: The words shown in the middle when the mode is text, such as a song title.

sub.description: The quieter supporting line at the bottom of the card.

tone.description: The colour of the supporting line: dim for normal, ok for good news, warn for something to watch, error for a problem.

accent.description: Edges the card in the accent colour to show it needs you now, such as a timer that is running.

state.description: How the card looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, unavailable when its device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device.

press.description: How the card shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole card, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

preview.description: Which picture to draw, as it appears at the top right of a Home card: agents, media, a dial, a switch, the clock, a timer, GitHub, energy or lightning.

value.description: The level the picture shows where it has one, such as how far round the dial is, from 0 to 100.

progress.description: For the timer picture: how much of the running timer is left, out of 1000; 0 when no timer runs (an empty ring).

on.description: Whether the thing the picture stands for is on, such as the switch or the dial's light.

unavailable.description: Shows the picture greyed out, for a device that cannot be reached.

quiet.description: For the lightning picture: shows a quiet sky with no recent strikes.

cells.description: The cells in order, separated by commas: c holds one component; p holds two half-height readouts, one above the other.

min-w.description: The narrowest a cell gets: tile-w for tiles (three to a row), home-card-min-w for Home cards (two to a row).

min-h.description: The shortest a cell gets: tile-h for tiles, card-h for Home cards.

last.description: A short last row: column keeps its cells the width of the rows above; fill lets them share the whole row (a lone Home card goes full width).

wide.description: Every cell on its own row, the full width: a wide card.

sample.description: For previews only: fills the cells with cards so the layout can be seen.

check.description: Where the item is: open not started, doing in progress with an accent dot, or done filled with a check mark.

label.description: The words next to the box.

interactive.description: Lets a tap move the box between open and done. Off makes it read-only.

state.description: default can be used; disabled is greyed out and ignores taps.

time.description: For previews only: a fixed time, like 10:08:30, that the seconds dot starts from. Leave empty for the real time.

animated.description: Moves the dots. Off holds them still where they start: a still picture.

sample.description: For previews only: the real Time with the date and a weather line in the centre, or none for the empty slot.

outline.description: For previews only: outlines the top and foot areas so you can see where the content and the buttons go.

on.description: What the marks sit on: box for a card or tile, button for a smaller button.

corners.description: Which corners get a mark: all four, or tr-bl for just top right and bottom left.

state.description: active shows the marks; active-pressed shows them while the active control is held; default hides them.

count.description: The number in the badge. Above 99 it shows 99+.

tone.description: The badge colour, by what the number means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

zero.description: What happens at zero: muted shows a quiet 0; hide removes the badge.

kind.description: What hangs in the window: a roller blind, a Venetian blind with slats, or a pair of curtains.

position.description: How open the cover is, from 0 (closed) to 100 (fully open).

tilt.description: For Venetian blinds: how far the slats are turned, from 0 (shut) to 100 (fully open).

heading.description: Where the cover is moving to while it moves, from 0 to 100, shown as a thin target line. -1 means it is not moving.

draggable.description: Lets you drag the blind's edge, or the curtains sideways, to move the cover.

size.description: screen is a window that fills the space it is in; card is the small picture at the top right of a Home card.

state.description: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be moved; unavailable shows the cover cannot be reached.

value.description: The value the dial is set to, between its lowest and highest.

min.description: The lowest value the dial goes down to.

max.description: The highest value the dial goes up to.

on.description: Whether the thing it controls is on. Off dims the dial; the button in the middle switches it.

caption.description: The word under the value that says what it is, such as Brightness.

unit.description: The unit shown after the value, such as % or °.

step.description: How much one step of the dial changes the value.

dimmable.description: Whether the value can be set. Off = an on/off light or a switch: the ring shows on or off, only the button in the middle works.

state.description: default can be turned; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device cannot be reached; missing shows there is no such device.

a.description: The size of the first part of the ring.

b.description: The size of the second part of the ring.

c.description: The size of the third part of the ring.

size.description: How wide the ring is across, in pixels.

icon.description: The icon at the top: done for all clear, alert for a problem, pr for pull requests.

title.description: The short heading that says nothing is here.

body.description: One quieter line under the heading that explains it.

tone.description: The icon's colour, by what the emptiness means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

icon.description: The icon on the tile, picked for the kind of thing it is, such as a bulb for a light or a door for a door sensor.

label.description: The thing's name on the tile.

status.description: The short state under the name, such as 64% or Off.

on.description: Whether the thing is on. On tiles are lit in the accent colour.

act.description: What a tap does: toggle switches it on or off, open opens its own screen, none does nothing.

state.description: How the tile looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, unavailable when the device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device.

press.description: How the tile shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole tile, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

on.description: What the outline goes round: box for a card or tile, button for a button, play for the round play button.

offset.description: The gap between the control and its outline: the usual focus gap, none for no gap, or a small or larger step.

disabled.description: Greys the outline, for a chosen control that cannot be used right now.

state.description: Where the update is: updating (about to install) or failed.

version.description: The version being installed. Empty hides it.

note.description: A line that replaces the default one, such as why it failed.

cols.description: How many columns, 1 to 8. Leave it out when min is set.

min.description: Instead of cols: the smallest cell, as an icon size step; the grid fits as many columns as it can, so a bigger screen gets more columns. none uses cols.

gap.description: The space between cells: none, near, group or block (from tight to roomy).

aspect.description: The cell shape: square, wide (16 by 9), row (as tall as what is inside, for text like stats), or hug (each cell as wide as what is inside, the row centred, like a bar of chips).

rows.description: At most this many rows; 0 for no limit. A list of items that does not fit shows a last cell with +N for the rest.

items.description: The list to repeat one cell per item: a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. Each cell is the node's cell template with $item (or $item.field) filled in; without a template, an icon named by the item.

empty.description: The words shown when the items list is empty.

outline.description: For previews only: outlines and names the cells so you can see where things go.

align.description: Where the parts line up: start is the left, centre is the middle (a stack centres each part), end is the right.

flow.description: wrap lays the parts side by side and starts a new line when the row is full; stack puts each part under the last.

gap.description: The room between the parts side by side: gutter, group for a few big controls in a row (the Media screen's previous, play and next), or near for a column of buttons that belong together.

space.description: The room above the group: none, group for related parts, block for separate blocks, near for parts that belong tightly together, line for a line that belongs to the block above, strip for a strip under a hero and its lines.

sample.description: For previews only: how many made-up tiles fill the row. 0 shows the empty layout.

label.description: The screen's name: the header puts a Title with these words in the title slot (empty = no title); a long one ends in an ellipsis. A component a screen puts in the title replaces it.

back.description: Shows the back button at the start, to return to the screen before.

clock.description: Shows the time at the end of the row.

time.description: For previews only: a fixed time to show, like 21:42. Leave empty for the real time.

settings.description: Puts the settings button in the end slot, before the time, as on Home.

sample.description: For previews only: fills a slot with real components to see how the row fits them (a screen places its own).

n.description: The big number, such as how many things need you.

unit.description: A unit shown after the number, such as kWh or °C. Leave empty for none.

count.description: Counts the number up from 0 when it first shows, and from the old value when it changes.

label.description: The words next to the number that say what it counts.

line.description: One quieter line with the detail, under the label.

accent.description: Draws the number in the accent colour, for when it matters now.

role.description: How big the number is: display is the largest, hero a step smaller for a screen's main figure, value smaller again for a hero inside a small space such as the compact Timer ring.

layout.description: row puts the label and line beside the number; stack puts the label above it and the line under it, centred, such as inside a ring; stack-start is the same column at the start (left), such as beside a picture.

label_type.description: How the words next to the number are written: label in small capitals, or title in larger plain text.

state.description: default shows the number; unavailable shows a dash when the value cannot be read.

style.description: The button's shape: play is the large round play and pause button, round is a smaller circle, square has rounded corners.

icon.description: The icon on the button, such as next, previous, play or close.

state.description: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, active when it is switched on, active-pressed while the active one is held, disabled when it cannot be used, unavailable when its device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device (the same look).

name.description: Which icon to show, by its name in the icon set (bulb, door, clear-day ...). Bind it to an entity with a map to change the icon with the entity's state; a name with no icon shows a quiet outlined box.

step.description: How big the icon is, as a size step from small up to hero. Each icon is made for some sizes only, so the icon snaps down to the nearest size it has. Leave it out when fit is cell.

fit.description: step: the size comes from step. cell: inside a grid cell or a layout slot, the icon takes the largest size that fits the cell, leaving a small margin. Use step or cell, not both.

tone.description: The icon's colour by what it means: ink for normal, dim for quiet, accent for the screen's colour, ok, warn, error or info for a status.

type.description: The text style, from the large title down to small meta text and capitals, as set in the type scale.

colour.description: The text colour: text for normal, text-dim for quieter, accent-text for the accent, blue, ok, warn, error, or disabled.

items.description: The colour keys, as words separated by commas, each one shown with its swatch, such as cheap 13.5p.

ticks.description: The labels along the bottom axis, separated by commas, spread evenly from left to right.

width.description: How wide the legend is, in pixels.

title.description: The main words of the row.

icon.description: The icon at the start of the row, or none.

sub.description: A quieter second line under the title. Leave empty for none.

under.description: A small capitals line under the title, such as a speaker's status in a choose-one list. A sub line takes its place.

tone.description: The icon and under line colour: dim for normal, working for something going on now, such as playing.

over.description: A small line above the title, for extra detail such as a flight's height and distance. Leave empty for none.

trailing.description: What sits at the right end: none, a value, a chevron to show it opens more, a value and a chevron, or an on/off switch.

value.description: The value shown at the right end when there is one, such as 42%.

on.description: Whether the switch at the right end is on.

state.description: How the row looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, disabled when it cannot be used, unavailable when its device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device.

act.description: tap: the row can be tapped; none: a read-out row that shows a value and takes no tap: no press look, no sound.

divider.description: Draws a thin line under the row to separate it from the next.

list.description: single is one row on its own; stack is a list of rows touching, with lines between them, one row per item of items.

items.description: With list stack: the rows, a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. Each row is this node's props with $item (or $item.field) filled in; a plain item is the row's title, and an object item's title (or name), icon, sub, over, under, tone, trailing, value, on and state fields fill the props that do not name $item. No items shows the empty words, never sample rows.

rows.description: With list stack: at most this many rows; 0 for up to 24. A longer list ends with a +N row for the rest.

empty.description: With list stack: the words shown when items is empty.

from.description: How the mood is chosen: mood picks it directly; agent works it out from what an agent is doing.

mood.description: The mascot's mood when picked directly: idle, working, done, needs you, error or sleeping.

kind.description: When the mood comes from an agent: what the agent is doing, working, needs you, done or idle.

status.description: When the mood comes from an agent: its status line, such as done 40m ago. A task done long ago turns the mascot idle.

colour.description: The mascot's colour: mood uses the mood's own colour, or accent, steel or warn for one fixed colour.

scale.description: How big the mascot is drawn, from 1 (screen size) to 4 times.

art.description: The album art's address (the player's picture).

artist.description: The artist, one line under it.

playing.description: Whether it is playing: only then is the picture shown.

visual.description: The picture: the plain disc with a progress ring, a cassette, a CD or a vinyl record.

state.description: What the player is doing, in small capitals: now playing, paused or idle.

tone.description: accent-text while it plays, text-dim otherwise.

title.description: The track, up to two lines.

progress.description: How far through the track it is, from 0 to 100.

playing.description: Whether it is playing: the picture turns.

art.description: The album art's address: printed on the disc, CD or record (Media visuals). Empty: the plain picture.

visual.description: What is drawn: the plain disc with a progress ring, a cassette, a CD or a vinyl record.

size.description: screen is the Media screen's picture; card is the small picture at the top right of its Home card (a square: the right end of a cassette).

progress.description: How far through the track it is, from 0 to 100. The tape moves from one reel to the other, or the tonearm moves in.

playing.description: Whether it is playing. While it plays the cassette reels or the disc turn at their real speed.

title.description: The track title, written on the cassette label or the record.

artist.description: The artist, written under the title.

art.description: The album art's address (the player's picture): printed on the disc face, the CD or the record's label. Empty, loading or failed: the plain drawing.

phase.description: Where the moon is in its month: 0 is new, 0.25 first quarter, 0.5 full, 0.75 last quarter.

size.description: How big the moon is drawn: the icon sizes, screen for the Moon screen's moon, tab a size down. Empty = card alone, feature in a column, screen as the hero.

south.description: Draws the moon as seen from the southern half of the world, where the lit side is the other way round.

layout.description: How the words sit with the moon: icon alone; column for one of the next phases (the phase and its day under it); hero for the Moon screen (the moon, then the phase and a line under it); line for that line alone.

label.description: The main words: the phase under the moon (column) or the phase name (hero), such as Full or Waxing gibbous.

value.description: When it comes, under the phase (column), such as Fri or 24 Oct.

line.description: The quieter rest of the hero line, such as 78% · full on Fri.

text.description: The words of the row, such as how many more items there are.

state.description: How the row looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or disabled when there is nothing more to open.

icon.description: The icon at the start of the row, such as a speaker or a TV, or none.

name.description: The option's name, such as the speaker's name.

status.description: The small capitals line under the name, such as what is playing there.

tone.description: The status colour: dim for normal, working for something going on now, such as playing.

selected.description: Whether this is the chosen option; its radio is on.

mark.description: radio for one option of a choose-one list; check for one of a pick-many list: a checkbox showing selected, the other rows untouched by a tap (the list sends the new selected).

state.description: How the row looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, disabled when it cannot be chosen, or unavailable when its device cannot be reached.

list.description: single is one row on its own; group is a choose-one list, one row per item of items, where a tap moves the choice.

items.description: With list group: the options, a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute (such as a media player's source list). Each row is this node's props with $item (or $item.field) filled in; a plain item is the row's name, and an object item's name, icon, status, tone, selected and state fields fill the props that do not name $item. No items shows the empty words, never sample rows.

rows.description: With list group: at most this many rows; 0 for up to 24. A longer list ends with a +N row for the rest.

empty.description: With list group: the words shown when items is empty.

value.description: How much is left: out of 1000, or out of max when max is set (such as seconds left of the timer's length).

max.description: What value counts up to, such as the timer's length in seconds. 0 means value is out of 1000.

size.description: normal is the full ring; compact is smaller, to leave room under it (the Timer with several timers).

state.description: default shows how much is left; unavailable shows the empty track when the value cannot be read.

sample.description: For previews only: a made-up Hero block in the centre (running, done or unavailable), or none for the empty slot.

text.description: What the QR code holds, usually a web address to open on your phone.

caption.description: The line under the code that says what scanning it does.

on.description: Whether this option is the chosen one; the ring fills in.

state.description: default can be chosen; disabled is greyed out.

bands.description: The price band of each slot from midnight, separated by commas: cheap, normal or peak. Any number of slots shares the day equally (24 = hours, 48 = half-hours).

now.description: Which slot is now, counting from 0; it gets the notch. -1 shows no notch.

width.description: How wide the strip is, in pixels; 0 fills the space it is in.

ticks.description: Hour labels under the strip, every this many hours (6 = 00, 06, 12, 18, 24); 0 shows none.

top.description: For previews only: the made-up readout in the top half of the slot, such as someone in the room or a door open.

label.description: The name of the thing it reports on. Leave empty to use the sample's own.

state.description: The state in words, such as 21.4° or Open.

detail.description: A quieter line after the state, such as how long ago it changed. Leave empty for none.

tone.description: The colour of the state: text for normal, accent for something notable, warn for something to check, mute for quiet.

bottom.description: For previews only: the made-up readout in the bottom half of the slot, or none.

items.description: The rows of the scrolling list, a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. A plain item is a row's title; an object item's title (or name), icon, sub, value, trailing, on and state fields make the row. Up to 24 rows, the last a +N row for the rest. No items shows the empty words, never sample rows.

empty.description: The words shown when items is empty.

height.description: How tall the list's visible area is, in pixels.

title.description: The caption that starts the group.

badge.description: Shows a count badge after the caption.

tone.description: The badge colour, by what the number means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

zero.description: What happens when the count is zero: muted shows a quiet 0; hide removes the badge.

right.description: What sits at the right end: none, meta for a quiet line of text, or action for a tappable link.

meta.description: The quiet text at the right end, such as when it was last updated.

action.description: The words of the link at the right end, such as See all.

state.description: How the link looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or disabled.

size.description: sm is the small capitals caption; label is the larger screen label style.

options.description: The choices, separated by commas, up to three.

selected.description: Which choice is picked, by its name in lower case.

width.description: hug fits the control to its words; fill stretches it across the space.

state.description: default can be tapped; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the setting cannot be read.

planes.description: The aircraft to draw, as the flights feed gives them: a list of [km, bearing in degrees, track in degrees, mark, callsign, hex], mark 1 for the lead one, 2 for an emergency; the callsign shows beside the plane on the radar size. Empty is a clear sky.

size.description: hero is the radar beside the aircraft on the Flight radar; radar is the big one on its Radar view, with ring numbers, callsigns and planes to tap; card is the small picture at the top right of a Home card, with dots.

unit.description: The distance unit of the rings: km (5, 15, 30, 50) or mi (3, 10, 20, 30), as Settings > Units says.

value.description: The value the slider is set to.

min.description: The lowest value, at the left end.

max.description: The highest value, at the right end.

step.description: How much the value changes from one position to the next.

state.description: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device has no state now; missing shows Home Assistant has no such device.

label.description: The name before the slider, in small capitals, such as vol.

value.description: Where the slider is, from 0 to 100.

text.description: The value shown after the slider, such as 42 (-- when it is not known).

state.description: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device has no state now; missing shows Home Assistant has no such device.

values.description: The recent values, as numbers separated by commas, oldest first.

colour.description: The line colour: steel, blue, accent, or text-dim for a quiet grey.

width.description: How wide the line is drawn, in pixels.

dot.description: Puts a dot on the latest value at the right end.

name.description: The speaker's name on the button, such as auto study when it follows you to the study.

playing.description: Whether something is playing. The icon turns orange while it plays.

icon.description: The icon on the button: speaker for media, a tennis ball or a goal for the sport screens' match picker, or none.

state.description: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or disabled.

art.description: Which side the card-wide column for the picture or control is on: left, or right with the words first (the Lightning map). The slots keep their numbers: 0 and 1 are always the picture column.

art_w.description: How wide the picture column is: card (a Home card's width), radar (the Lightning radar's square, wider) or qr (a QR code block's width, narrower).

art_mid.description: Centres the picture column's top slot down the screen instead of at the top (the Lightning radar).

art_fill.description: Makes the picture column's top slot the whole column, for a picture as tall as the screen (the Blinds window).

outline.description: For previews only: outlines the two columns and their top and foot areas so you can see where things go.

label.description: The small capitals line that says what the fact is, such as trend.

value.description: The fact itself, such as 48 km/h.

tone.description: The colour of the value: dim for quiet, text for normal, warn for something to watch, ok for good news.

size.description: title is the usual value; body is a smaller value, for a row of facts in a narrow column (the Flight radar's hero, docs .fs-stat).

state.description: default shows the value; unavailable shows a dash when it cannot be read.

tone.description: The chip's colour, by what it reports: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

text.description: The short words on the chip.

size.description: chip is the pill with its words; dot is the coloured dot alone, the smallest way to show a state.

pulse.description: Makes the dot pulse gently, for something happening now.

tone.description: The dot's colour, by what the line reports: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

ink.description: The words' colour: text, or dim for a quieter line, such as a check that passed beside one that failed.

style.description: headline for a screen's big line, body for a paragraph, label for a small line in capitals.

tone.description: default is the main text colour; dim is the quieter one for explanations.

lines.description: How many lines it may take, from 1 to 4. It is always that tall; words that do not fit end in an ellipsis.

count.description: How many ticks go round the ring.

range.description: How far round the ring goes, in degrees: 360 is a full circle, 270 leaves a gap at the bottom like a dial.

size.description: How wide the ring is across, in pixels.

stride.description: Every how many ticks a longer major tick is drawn. 0 draws them all the same.

numbers.description: Writes a number by each major tick, as on a clock.

lit.description: How much of the ring is lit in the accent, from 0 to 100. -1 lights none.

title.description: The agent's name, over up to two lines.

kind.description: What the agent is doing: working, needs you, done or idle. The mascot's mood follows it.

status.description: The status line at the bottom, such as how far it has got.

state.description: How the tile looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or unavailable when the agent cannot be reached.

press.description: How the tile shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole tile, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

size.description: How big the digits are: header for the time at the end of every screen's header (small caps, dim), compact for a small clock, mid for a card, hero for a screen's main figure.

font.description: The typeface of the digits: mono is the fixed-width face, inter the rounder everyday face.

format.description: 24h shows 13:00; 12h shows 1:00 with AM or PM.

seconds.description: Shows the seconds as well as hours and minutes.

date.description: The date under the time: none, short like MON 19 OCT, or long like Monday 19 October. The header size never shows one.

line.description: A quieter line under the date, such as the weather now. Only with a date; leave it out for none.

digits.description: Shows the time itself. Off leaves the date alone, for a face that tells the time another way.

time.description: For previews only: a fixed time to show, like 14:52:20. Leave empty for the real time.

day.description: For previews only: a fixed date to show, like 2026-10-19. Leave empty for today.

name.description: The timer's name, such as Eggs. Empty leaves the name out and makes the countdown the main text (the Timer bar).

key.description: What a tap sends to say which timer it is, such as its id. Empty sends the name.

total.description: The timer's whole length in seconds; the mini ring shows left out of it.

state.description: running counts down; idle is set but not running; done has run out and shows DONE in the accent (a tap stops it).

active.description: Marks the chip whose timer is shown in the big ring.

unavailable.description: Shows the chip greyed out when the timer cannot be read; a tap does nothing but say so.

text.description: The words to show, like Living room. It can follow an entity's name.

icon.description: The icon at the start, picked for what the message is about, such as a timer, a person or a washing machine.

tone.description: The icon's colour, by what the message means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

body.description: One line of detail under the heading.

action.description: The words of a button on the message, such as Open. Leave empty for no button.

timer.description: Shows a thin bar that runs down until the message goes away on its own.

life.description: How long the message stays: normal, or urgent which stays much longer.

position.description: Where messages appear: from the top or from the bottom of the screen.

push.description: For previews only: the tone of the first sample message that arrives, or none.

stack.description: For previews only: how many sample messages are stacked, up to two showing at once.

timer.description: Shows the bar on each message that runs down until it goes away.

action.description: For previews only: gives the sample messages a button.

screen.description: For previews only: draws a sample screen under the messages.

state.description: default can be tapped; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device has no state now; missing shows Home Assistant has no such device.

value.description: How full the ring is, from 0 to 100: the run's progress while it cleans, else the battery.

run.description: run while it is out cleaning (the ring and the LiDAR in the accent), idle at rest (the battery in grey), off when it cannot be reached (the empty track).

icon.description: Which weather to show, such as partly cloudy by day, rain or a clear night.

size.description: How big the icon is drawn, from the small sizes in text up to the hero size of a screen.

animated.description: Makes the icon's parts move gently: rays turn, clouds drift, rain falls. With reduced motion it stays still.

on.description: What the icon alone sits on: canvas for the screen background, card for a Card-coloured surface round it.

layout.description: How the words sit with the icon: icon alone; column for one of the next hours (the hour over it, the temperature under it); row for one of the next days (day, icon, weather, low, high); hero for the weather now (the temperature with the icon at the end, the condition and a line under it).

label.description: The main words: the hour over the icon (column), the day (row) or the condition (hero), such as now, Saturday or Partly cloudy.

value.description: The temperature: under the icon (column), the high at the end (row), or the big one (hero), such as 13°.

line.description: A quieter line: the day's weather and rain (row), or feels like, high and low (hero).

low.description: The day's low, before its high (row).

accent.description: Draws the hour in the accent colour: the hour now (column).

divider.description: Draws the List row's thin line above the row, for every day after the first (row).
